title: Pro Shop Store Credit: dues-standing gate on the closure settlement
content:
## Applies to
Pro Shop Store Credit: this document covers the dues-standing condition on the final closure settlement, for every tier of this product.

## Basis
The refunded portion of a closure settlement is issued only while the member's separately-held club membership account currently carries no outstanding dues balance. Where that membership account's dues balance is greater than zero, the full sum still standing on the account is instead forfeited in its entirety, and none of it is refunded, regardless of which percentage branch the closure-settlement threshold would otherwise have selected.
